greeting: Abyssal on comms. Stage 5: The Abyssal Vault. Keep formation tight and decisions tighter.
We are running Depths of Mystery. Objective drift gets teams buried.
A pigeon outranked three commanders here last week. Merit system is broken.
Action first, panic never. Start with: Infiltrate the Abyssal Vault.
dialog.quest_hook: Objective stack: Infiltrate the Abyssal Vault; Disrupt the Void gateway ritual; Prevent the Door from opening. Keep route integrity while pressure escalates.
dialog.quest_active: Active pressure: Descend into the deepest ocean trench to stop the Void ritual. Immediate move: Infiltrate the Abyssal Vault.
dialog.quest_complete: Stage 5 resolved: The Abyssal Vault. Primary objective secured and route stabilized. Prepare for Rising Tide.
rumor: Tide monks claim the trench listens when spoken to politely.
People keep repeating one clue from The Abyssal Vault: 'Prevent the Door from opening'.
The compass spun, laughed, and still pointed exactly where we needed to go.
dialog.time_dawn: Dawn tide is calm enough for precision dives. Best window for route checks.
dialog.time_noon: Noon currents fight each other in the trench. Anchor and communicate.
dialog.time_dusk: Dusk visibility drops fast underwater. Stay on beacon chain.
dialog.time_night: Night tide carries deep-song interference. Confirm orders twice.

party_reactions.kade: Abyssal sounds intense, but the plan is solid. We keep moving.
party_reactions.nix7: Tactical profile for Abyssal accepted. Probability of success improves with compliance.
party_reactions.twist: Abyssal talks scary, but I like it. We punch the problem and then celebrate.

relationship_dialog.stranger: State your objective in one sentence.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Welcome back. What changed since last pass?
relationship_dialog.friend: Good. We move cleaner when we move together.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: No masks, no theater, just us and the objective.
